descriptions.w3d_d28b_homing_update_8009f86c: Homing projectile steering: stops within the weapon reach of the destination +308; sweeps up and down by rate over frame time (virtual slot +64), then along the velocity by reach over frame time; on a hit adds lift, or subtracts it when only the up sweep hit, subtracts the pull toward 0x8043ae20 and integrates the velocity +48; always renormalizes the velocity and clamps its length to the weapon limit +564.
